title: the bench is readable as data, not only as a table
question: does `bb bench show --json` emit the totals a dashboard reads?

steps.name: it emits totals with both arms
and the saved share is derived from them, not stored separately
steps.run: node bin/bb.js bench show --json | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const t=JSON.parse(s).totals;const p=Math.round((t.saved/t.bare)*1000)/10;process.stdout.write(Math.abs(p-t.saved_pct)<0.2?'consistent':'drift '+p+' vs '+t.saved_pct)})"
